text:
mike: FYI rolled adaptive-kernel-hint last night; since then host p99 overhead up ~2.9ms and syscall rate increased. seeing more smallwrite paths.
anya: any flamegraphs/traces you can share?
mike: uploaded trace: s3://perf/redwood/4951239999/hint-fallback-flame.svg
mike: quick flame snippet:
```
parse_preflight  | memcpy 3.9ms
socket_writev   | 14 calls -> 26 calls per req
```
ryan: hypothesis: the hint toggles kernel selection and makes us fall back to the mini-batch->smallwrite path, causing extra buffer copies.
ben: ran eBPF counts on canary this morning: smallwrite syscalls/sec doubled; memcpy bytes +22%.
lisa: also seeing gRPC header fragmentation on some client connections. HPACK + TLS record boundaries produces smaller iovecs, increasing syscall overhead. :facepalm:
anya: can we reproduce locally? ryan, can you run a microbench matrix: (a) hint off (b) hint on (c) force writev coalesce (d) force smallwrite path.
ryan: on it. pushing bench script: ./bench/smallwrite_matrix.sh
mike: let's also add a lightweight kv tracer; if parse stalls we may push more KV lookups off-critical-path and increase misses.
ben: added kv-hit/miss tracer to pool-b canary, dumping to statsd.
lisa: toggled socket.writev_coalesce=true on pool-b to test impact.
deploy-bot: flag change: pool-b socket.writev_coalesce=true by @lisa at 2026-03-21T09:03:11Z
ryan: microbench (summary):
- baseline (hint off, coalesce on): writev calls 6, memcpy 1.1MB/s, p99 overhead 1.1ms
- hint on, coalesce on: writev calls 10, memcpy 1.3MB/s, p99 3.8ms
- hint on, coalesce off (forced smallwrite): writev syscalls 24, memcpy 1.9MB/s, p99 4.5ms
anya: clear signal: fragmentation + smallwrite fallback is the dominant cost.
mike: rollback plan: disable adaptive-kernel-hint in canary and re-evaluate; if p99 returns to baseline we revert globally.
ben: kv tracer shows miss rate +4% during hint-on windows, which explains extra blocking lookups.
lisa: with coalesce=true on pool-b writev syscalls dropped and p99 improved ~1.6ms.
mike: immediate action items:
- roll adaptive-kernel-hint off in next canary wave
- instrument kernel-selection entry point to avoid extra copies on fallback (add metrics: fallback_count, extra_memcpy_bytes)
- add unit/integration test ensuring writev coalescing remains enabled across kernel-hint transitions
anya: filing RFC for kernel-hint behavior and the test additions; tagging eng-runtime on PR.
ryan: PR #1248 will include the microbench harness, perf graphs, and repro steps.
mike: I'll monitor canary for 1h after rollback and post numbers. ping here if you see regressions in dedicated clusters.
